fly_lgmd_eta — FLYVISION looming op

• Data kinds: signal → signal

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.fly_lgmd_eta(theta_signal, dt_s, alpha=4.7, delay_s=0.0) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import flyvision; flyvision.fly_lgmd_eta(theta_signal, dt_s, alpha=4.7, delay_s=0.0), registry से लेना हो तो opsflyvision.get("fly_lgmd_eta"))

उपयोग

फैलते subtended angle से LGMD/eta looming response।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

The multiplicative looming model::

eta(t) = theta'(t - delay) * exp(-alpha * theta(t - delay))

where *theta_signal* is the object's full subtended angle over time, in radians. The product of the angular expansion rate and an exponentially decaying gain gives a response that peaks a fixed time before collision.

theta_signal: the full subtended angle per sample, radians.

dt_s: the sample interval, seconds.

alpha: the gain-decay constant.

delay_s: a fixed neural delay, seconds.

Returns a 1-D float64 array eta(t) of the same length.

Ground truth: for an object of half-size l approaching at speed |v|, eta peaks at a time-to-contact of alpha*l/|v| - delay_s (Gabbiani et al. Eq. 5), where the subtended angle is exactly 2*atan(1/alpha) (Eq. 6; 24.0 degrees for alpha = 4.7) — both pinned in the tests.

Raises ValueError: a non-1-D / empty / too-short (< 3) / non-finite *theta_signal*, a signal over MAX_SIGNAL_POINTS, a non-positive *dt_s* / *alpha*, and a negative *delay_s*.
